desc: Implement DSU (union-find) with path compression and union by rank over indices 0..n-1.
Build a map from value -> index for nums[i] <= threshold; values > threshold remain isolated singletons.

Replace incorrect d-hub loop with rep[L] approach: for each present value v (index i), iterate multiples L of v up to threshold; union i with rep[L] if set, else set rep[L] = i. Justification: a|L and b|L implies lcm(a,b)|L <= threshold, so all present divisors of L form a clique; every edge (a,b) is witnessed at L = lcm(a,b).
Count unique DSU roots across all n indices and return.

Validate correctness: trace example 1 (expect 4: (2,4),(3),(8),(9)) and example 2 (expect 2: (2,3,4,8,9),(12)); confirm no overconnection (e.g., 2 and 3 with threshold 5 stay separate since no common multiple L <= 5 exists).

Test edge cases: single element, all values > threshold, threshold = 1, large primes, and performance with n = 1e5, threshold = 2e5 (total ops = sum over present v of threshold/v = O(threshold log threshold)).
